hero.bio: Developer focused on writing clean, scalable and maintainable code. Looking to join a team where I can add value from day one and keep growing professionally.

tineverse.description:
• Developed a REST API with Python and FastAPI to centralize and expose real-time status of all ski resort slopes in Spain, implementing a web scraping system for automatic data extraction and updating.
• Built the audiovisual playback control system for a 360° immersive projection room using TypeScript, React, and Next.js, managing the broadcast of content stored in Disguise, YouTube videos, and the company's own live streams.
• Implemented a real-time people detection and tracking system using YOLO, sending the obtained coordinates via OSC protocol to Notch to generate interactive visual effects on the room's floor. Designed the geometric mapping algorithm to transform coordinates captured by a wall-mounted camera with inclination (3D plane) to a precise 2D coordinate system, resolving capture perspective distortion.
• Developed and maintained a marine data tracking web application using data collected by buoys and other sensors, integrating WMS/WMTS layers and representing the information on an interactive 3D globe.

porcelanosa.description:
• Developed, as my Bachelor's Thesis, an order management web application with generative AI integration to automate data extraction from heterogeneous invoices, a process that was previously entered manually into the company's internal system.
• The AI extraction module was integrated into the company's real processes, significantly reducing manual data entry time.
